github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject. The type decides whether the commit lands in the release changelog.
feat/fix/perf are ONLY for changes visible to the editor user. Mark infrastructure (CI, workflows, configs, .vscode, .github, build scripts) as ci/build/chore, tests as test, documentation as docs.
fix is a fix of an editor behavior bug that the user notices. Lint, formatting, import order and code typo fixes are style, NOT fix. Test/config fixes are test/chore, not fix.
Refactoring is refactor (it does not go to the changelog, except a breaking refactor!:). Mark breaking changes with a ! suffix or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer.
Subject: imperative, lowercase, no trailing period. For feat/fix describe the user-facing effect, not the internal implementation. Details are in docs/COMMITS.md.
